data.title: Niamey back to normal after soldier mutiny
data.description: ABIDJAN - Life returned to normal in Niger's capital, Niamey, on Sunday, after the military regime and its Russian paramilitary partners put down a mutiny by soldiers.

data.title: Grisly search for missing as Nepal morgues overflow, burials begin
data.description: BHâRATPUR (NEPAL) - Distraught families in Nepal watched grisly images of mangled corpses on a screen on Sunday, seeking to identify relatives as overflowing morgues forced authorities to begin burying flood victims.

data.title: At least six die in ferry capsize off Northern Cyprus
data.description: ISTANBUL - At least six people died when a ferry capsized off Northern Cyprus on Sunday, the head of the local government said, in a preliminary toll to Turkish media.

data.title: No evidence yet of arson in Klongthom Centre fire
data.description: Police have so far found no evidence of arson in the Klongthom Shopping Centre fire to support speculation of a conspiracy to force some businesses out, Bangkok Governor Chadchart Sittipunt said on Sunday.

data.title: Pattaya street hookers arrested ahead of US carrier group's visit
data.description: PATTAYA - Police and human security officials arrested Thai, Lao and Ugandan women for alleged street prostitution on Saturday night, oonly days ahead of the arrival of about 5,000 crew and marines aboard a US navy strike group.

data.title: Man arrested for B5m bomb-assisted gold robbery
data.description: SA KAEO - A suspect was arrested at his home in Aranyaprathet district on Sunday after a local gold shop was bombed and robbed of gold necklaces worth about 5 million baht on Thursday.

data.title: Manhunt in Switzerland after deadly rave shooting
data.description: AARAU, Switzerland - Swiss police were on Sunday hunting gunmen who opened fire at a rave, killing one person and wounding five others, some of them seriously.

data.title: Nepal rescuers drill through debris towards trapped tunnel workers
data.description: KATHMANDU (NEPAL) - Nepali rescuers trying to reach hydropower workers believed trapped in tunnels swamped by flood debris deployed heavy machinery on Sunday, after rain and rising river waters hampered earlier efforts.

data.title: Norway's churches hold services for late King Harald
data.description: ASKER (NORWAY) - Norway's new King Haakon VIII attended a memorial service Sunday, as churches across the Scandinavian kingdom paid tribute to his father, king Harald, who passed away two days before.

data.title: Manhunt in Switzerland after fatal rave shooting
data.description: AARAU, Switzerland - Swiss police were on Sunday hunting gunmen who opened fire at a rave, killing one person and wounding five others, some of them seriously.

data.title: PM attributes continuing southern violence to intensified law enforcement
data.description: The continuing criminal violence in the southern border provinces is a response to intensified enforcement of the law, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Sunday.

data.title: Van driver caught with 4m meth pills
data.description: AMNAT CHAROEN - Police seized 4 million methamphetamine pills worth an estimated 200 million baht and arrested a van driver following a late-night chase in this northeastern province.

data.title: ONE Championship: Ubaid Hussain targets Qatar, Johan Ghazali after US$100,000 contract win
data.description: Ubaid Hussain has set his sights on ONE Championship’s 2027 return to Qatar after finally securing a US$100,000 main-roster contract – with Johan Ghazali already emerging as a potential future rival.

data.title: Man with knife arrested at school earlier drank pig's blood and beer
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA - Police were called to arrest a man who was acting weirdly in a school yard after earlier drinking pig's blood and beer, in Khon Buri district.

data.title: Gunmen storm Pattani department store, set off bombs
data.description: PATTANI - Armed insurgents stormed into a big department store in Pattani on Saturday evening, forcing customers and employees to leave before detonating three bombs.

data.title: Nepal flood survivors return to ruins to salvage memories
data.description: DHUNGE (NEPAL) - Days after a wall of water and debris ripped through Nepal, Shanti Lamichhane sat on a fruit crate in the dirt where her village once stood, staring at what remained of her home.

data.title: Rescuers dig into tunnel as missing toll from Nepal, China flood nears 3,000
data.description: BIDUR (NEPAL) - Rescuers in Nepal and China battled Sunday to find thousands missing after a deadly wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayas, engulfing entire villages.

data.title: Australian right-wing party steals Labor seat in Perth
data.description: SYDNEY - The ⁠right-wing One Nation ⁠party has won a seat ​in a state parliament long held by Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's centre-left ​Labor Party, continuing a surge that ‌recently gained the populist group its first seat in the national lower house of parliament.

data.title: Heavy rain forecast over most of Thailand
data.description: The Meteorological Department forecast is for heavy rain in western parts of the North, the Central Plain, the upper and eastern parts of the Northeast and the East from Sunday to Wednesday.

data.title: Killing of Palestinian children and teens by Israel surges in West Bank
data.description: RAMALLAH (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - Alia al-Hallaq's son Mohammed was nine when he was killed by an Israeli army bullet last October, but the Palestinian homemaker still speaks of herself as a mother of five, not four.
